notes: 1. By spacing and color patterning, the quipu is separated into 3 parts: part 1 is 3 groups, and parts 2 and 3 are 7 groups each. 2. Many values are uncertain due to breakage. However, we hypothesize that, position by position, values in group 1 of part 1 are related to the sums of values in groups 2 and 3 while values in groups 2 and 3 are related to sums of values in parts 2 and 3 respectively.
